title: 第1381章 秋后算账第1380章 准备大战
content_zh:
“或许，交给暗影会，
何尝不是这孩子的另外一番机缘。”
听闻此话，长公主有些意外的盯了一眼齐长风。
早就听闻那混蛋的大徒弟完美的继承了李太玄身上的推演大神通，如今看来，所言非虚。
思考再三，长公主也是点点头道：
“可以。”
话音落下的瞬间，她便是话锋一转道：
“不过。。。”
“神魔之躯给你可以，但，本公主有个条件，你能答应，便带走，不能便免提。”
黑白身躯的半帝强者微眯着双眸，随后冷笑一声道：
“长公主殿下，不妨说说看？”
顿了顿，她缓缓道：
“把青阳交出来。”
闻言。
黑白身躯的半帝强者有些意外，愣神片刻后大笑道：
“看来你对叛徒还真的是格外的关注啊。”
“哈哈哈哈，我说长公主殿下，还以为是什么条件呢，就这？”
“好办！”
随后，他打了个响指，瞬间消失在原地。
仅仅只是数息的时间，便是再次出现。

唯一不同的是，手中提着一个身穿青色长衫，满脸惊恐的青阳圣王！
当他看到朝着他缓缓走来的帝流儿更是当场声泪俱下，惊惧道：
“长。。。长公主殿下？！”
“您！您怎么出关？！”
而自己不过是刚刚叛出了帝宫，她便是现身在此地，那他的下场可想而知。
想到这，他当即看向了黑白身躯的半帝强者，发了疯一般求饶道：
“长老，您不能这样做！我可是对暗影会忠心耿耿啊！天地可鉴！”
“即便是没有功劳，也有苦劳啊，您不能把我交给人族！”
对此，黑白身躯的半帝强者冷笑一声：
“噗呲，好一个忠心耿耿，天地可鉴。”
“那么好，如今，便是你表忠心，为暗影会做出贡献的时候，去吧。”
“不不不！！！”
“不！”
帝流儿见状极为失望的摇摇头，凤眸深处掠过一抹实质化的杀机。
若是青阳方才第一时间及时认错，态度诚恳真挚的话，她还是有几分考虑的机会。
如今，没机会了。
一缕缕滔天恐怖的帝威从长公主身上绽放，挥手间，无尽的圣王之力裹挟着淡淡帝意朝着青阳周身汇聚。
而后，猛然压缩轰然爆炸！
砰！！！
“不！救。。。”话还未完全说完，青阳全身直接是化作了一团血雾，连带着神魂和神桥底蕴根基彻底湮灭在世间。

太华，炼狱等圣王强者见状皆是微微叹气摇头。
一位圣王强者，就这么没了，
对人族没有损失，自然是假的。
但他们都知道，长公主殿下对于叛徒，向来都是零容忍。
“啪啪啪！”鼓掌声响起。
content_en:
"Perhaps, leave it to the Shadow Society,
Isn't this another opportunity for this child? "
Hearing this, the eldest princess stared at Qi Changfeng in surprise.
I had long heard that the bastard's great disciple had perfectly inherited Li Taixuan's great deduction power, and now it seemed that what he said was true.
After thinking again and again, the eldest princess nodded and said:
"Okay."
The moment she finished speaking, she changed the subject and said:
"But..."
"I can give you the body of a god and demon, but this princess has a condition. If you agree, you can take it with you. If you can't, you can take it away."
The strong half-emperor with a black and white body narrowed his eyes slightly, then sneered and said:
"Your Highness, the eldest princess, why don't you tell me?"
After a pause, she said slowly:
"Hand over Qingyang."
Hear the words.
The black-and-white half-emperor was a little surprised. He was stunned for a moment and then laughed and said:
"It seems that you really pay special attention to traitors."
"Hahahaha, I said to Her Royal Highness the Princess, what kind of conditions did you think it was, that's it?"
"Easy to handle!"
Then, he snapped his fingers and disappeared instantly.
It only took a few seconds for it to appear again.
The only difference is that he is holding a Qingyang Holy King wearing a blue gown with a frightened face!
When he saw Di Liuer slowly walking towards him, he burst into tears on the spot and said in fear:
"Elder...Her Royal Highness the eldest princess?!"
"You! How did you get out of seclusion?!"
And he had just betrayed the imperial palace, and she appeared here, so one can imagine his fate.
Thinking of this, he immediately looked at the black-and-white half-emperor and begged for mercy like crazy:
"Elder, you can't do this! I am loyal to the Shadow Society! Heaven and earth can learn from this!"
"Even if there is no merit, there is still hard work. You can't leave me to the human race!"
In response, the black and white half-emperor sneered:
"Pfft, what a loyal person, and the world can learn from him."
"Okay then, now is the time for you to show your loyalty and contribute to the Shadow Society. Go ahead."
"No no no!!!"
"No!"
Di Liu'er shook his head in great disappointment when he saw this, and a hint of substantial murderous intention flashed deep in his phoenix eyes.
If Qingyang had just admitted her mistake immediately and acted sincerely, she would still have a chance to consider it.
Now, there is no chance.
Wisps of terrifying imperial power bloomed from the eldest princess. With her hand, the endless power of the Holy King gathered around Qingyang with a hint of imperial will.
Then, it suddenly compressed and exploded!
Bang! ! !
"No! Save..." Before he could finish his words, Qingyang's whole body turned into a ball of blood mist, and his soul and the foundation of Shenqiao were completely annihilated in the world.
Taihua, Purgatory and other powerful Saint Kings all sighed slightly and shook their heads when they saw this.
A strong Saint King was just gone.
There is no loss to the human race, so it is naturally false.
But they all know that Her Royal Highness the Princess has always had zero tolerance for traitors.
"Bah bang bang!" Applause sounded.
